aiResearchSummary.text: CrowdStrike is researching cloud and endpoint security, AI, and data protection. Securing function as a service cloud computing environments and Cloud-based File Integrity Monitoring focus on protecting cloud workloads. Representation-agnostic file classifier, Semi-supervised malware classification using representation-agnostic and Machine learning-based malware detection for code reflection address advanced malware detection. Machine learned contextual cybersecurity threat prioritization and Machine learned malicious predictions enhance detection scoring and prioritization across environments.
